installation.source: The bundle contains a runtime wheel, hashed requirements.lock, install.py, smoke.py and a small usage guide. Setup downloads pinned dependencies; no models or providers are installed.
installation.configure: Run bundle/install.py with explicit destination/state/input/skills roots. It verifies an isolated installed runtime and returns a stable proposed pace-mcp.json plus an optional Pace procedure.
installation.activate: Merge the proposed mcpServers entry through the host's generic MCP configuration. Pace has a fixed native catalog; this bundle does not register a new catalog row or modify the host application.
